derivation: of Chaldee origin (meaning our Lord has come);
def: maranatha, i.e. an exclamation of the approaching divine judgment

occurrences.text: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maran-atha.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
